name: glowing-text
title: Glowing Text
description: Terminal-style typewriter text where the active line types in bold glow and settles to a dim, regular weight once complete.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Body text size in vw units.

props.name: characterStagger
props.description: Delay between each character starting its reveal.

props.name: revealDuration
props.description: How long each character takes to fade in and settle.

props.name: lineGap
props.description: Extra pause after a line's last word before the next line starts.
